Note the number after the dash for the Mobile App workstream (e.g. if it's PROJ-03, the workstream number is 3).\n\n**Step 2: Add the task**\n```\nbrain pm task add \"Your task name\" --workstream <number>\n```\n\nFor example, if Mobile App is workstream 3:\n```\nbrain pm task add \"Implement push notifications\" --workstream 3\n```\n\n**Full options available:**\n```\nbrain pm task add \"Task name\" \\\n  --workstream <n>            # Workstream number (required to target a specific workstream)\n  --project <prefix>          # Project prefix (uses active project if omitted)\n  --priority <critical|high|medium|low>\n  --mode <auto|interactive|review>\n  --category <cat>\n  --depends-on <id1> <id2>    # Task IDs this depends on\n  --json                      # Output JSON\n```\n\n**Example with all options:**\n```\nbrain pm task add \"Add offline sync\" \\\n  --workstream 3 \\\n  --priority high \\\n  --mode interactive \\\n  --category implementation\n```\n\nNew tasks are created with `status: pending` by default. The task gets a display ID like `PROJ-03.04` (project-workstream.task_number).\n\n**Note:** There is no \"Mobile App\" workstream in the currently active project (VOLTR / voltras-workspace).
